title: Carbon
no_data: No carbon data available yet. Run a calculation to see results.
error_no_entity: Select a parcel to calculate carbon
missing_none: No data missing for this campaign
no_soil_balance: No soil balance for this campaign
no_projection: No projection: a complete campaign with a soil balance is needed
not_certified: Monitoring estimate, not certified. It does not replace carbon-credit verification.

missing.ndvi: NDVI scenes missing on crop days
missing.soil: No soil data for the parcel
missing.soil_soc: Invalid soil organic carbon or bulk density
missing.vi_type: The crop is calibrated on a vegetation index the platform does not publish
missing.harvest_export: Harvest weight, moisture or area missing
missing.residue_removal: Baling without a declared share of straw removed
missing.cycles: No crop cycles: counted as bare soil
missing.cycle_biomass: Data missing for part of the crop cycle
missing.cover_mismatch: NDVI shows vegetation on days without a crop cycle
missing.osavi: OSAVI scenes missing on woody-crop days: compute OSAVI in Vegetation
missing.cycle_lifecycle: Lifecycle not recorded: perennial inferred from the species
missing.cycle_end: Planned end date has passed without a recorded end

effect.tier1_unavailable: No plant production for that crop
effect.cover_uncertain: Soil cover uncertain: check the crop cycles

gap.open_campaign: The last campaign is still open
gap.baseline_incomplete: SOC change missing in some campaign (project or baseline)

olive_soc_required: Soil analysis required for olive groves (Tier 2+)
harvest_export_pct: Exported at harvest (% of above-ground biomass)
declare_hint: Leave empty what you do not know: the balance only uses what you declare here.
hint_export: Only if the harvest has no recorded weight and moisture
hint_removal: For example, baled straw. Applies only when a baling is recorded
hint_n: Only if no fertilization is recorded in field operations
hint_irrigation: Only if no irrigation is recorded in field operations
recorded_elsewhere: Tillage, cover crops and weather are not declared here: they come from field operations, crop cycles and the parcel weather.

data.no_scenes: No satellite scenes in the period
data.no_operations: No completed operations in the period
data.irrigation_unknown: no irrigation recorded or declared (treated as rainfed)

baseline_incomplete: No reduction computable: SOC change missing (project or baseline) in {{years}}

assumption.repeat_reference: Climate and management of {{year}} repeated every year
assumption.no_baseline: No baseline defined: only the current management is projected
assumption.baseline_same_climate: Baseline: management of {{year}} under the same climate
